shots.detail_en: Early-morning empty 90s Hong Kong cha chaan teng, corner table in slanted dawn light; three objects in a row on red vinyl tabletop: a worn hand-drawn candlestick notebook, open ledger pages, a black pager; young man in white shirt sits alone
shots.sub: 三只眼睛看见的是同一根线——线的那头，在机房。
shots.speaker: 旁白
shots.fx: morning street ambience with faint ticker-board echo

shots.detail_en: Close-up of ledger page, three hand-drawn arrows in red ink; a woman's fingertip slides along the arrows and stops on the third one
shots.sub: 联华永盛的钱过三道手——第三道手，十年前就存在。
shots.speaker: 红利

shots.detail_en: Macro of the notebook's last page: hand-drawn candlestick bars beside a handwritten string of symbols and digits, middle section softly blurred; white shirt cuff at frame edge
shots.sub: 父亲记的不是行情——是那只看得见他的眼睛。
shots.speaker: 长虹

shots.detail_en: Exchange hall counter at opening bell; young man in white shirt fills out a small paper order slip under a wall board reading LIANHUA YONGSHENG, stylized, no fine detail
shots.sub: 爸，按你 93 年的节奏，先敲三下门。
shots.speaker: 长虹

shots.detail_en: Top-down shot of three small paper order slips lined up on the counter like three small stones
shots.speaker: 旁白

shots.detail_en: Crowded 90s exchange hall, giant red-and-green flip board churning numbers; young man in white shirt stands motionless among the crowd, eyes lowered
Second-floor machine room, rack of monitors; one screen lights up with a stylized blood-red PREY-ENTERING mark; young man in all-black minimalist suit, rimless glasses, standing before it
shots.sub: 他来了——用他自己敲门的方式。
shots.speaker: 熊伟

shots.detail_en: Screen close-up: an abstract pressure curve pressing down block by block, stylized non-real interface; glasses reflecting the glow
shots.sub: 样本编号醒了。反应值，和十年前同频。
shots.speaker: 熊伟

shots.detail_en: Night cha chaan teng under warm lamp: a trade-confirmation slip and the ledger page side by side; young man and young woman freeze at the same instant mid-comparison, rain streaking the window behind
shots.sub: 这套系统，十年前就在跑。
shots.speaker: 红利

shots.detail_en: Close-up of a red ballpoint drawing one long line from today's clearing mark across the page to the 93 symbol string
shots.sub: 两串数字，一种呼吸——账在替谁说话，就归谁管。
shots.speaker: 红利

shots.detail_en: The notebook's 93 margin notes held beside the confirmation slip; the two handwriting rhythms visually identical; young man's eyes tracking line to line
shots.sub: 反手、压单、再反手……父亲的页边，早写好了这口气。
shots.speaker: 长虹

shots.detail_en: Young man presses the closed notebook flat against his chest, eyes shut, single warm lamp overhead
Flashback 1993: cavernous old trading hall flooded with red flip-board glow; middle-aged father in an old suit, head bowed, writing in the notebook margin
Young man tucks the notebook inside his jacket, opens his eyes, gaze hardening
shots.sub: 爸，这只眼睛——我替你看回去。
shots.speaker: 长虹

shots.detail_en: Wide shot, next-day opening: packed retail hall, sea of investors, giant flip board rolling red and green, morning light through high windows
Young man amid the retail crowd tilts his head up toward the second-floor machine-room glass, light flaring on the glass
shots.sub: 他们不知道——我们看见他们了。
shots.speaker: 旁白

shots.detail_en: Inside the machine room the man in black happens to look down through the glass at the hall crowd, monitor glow on his lenses
shots.sub: 样本在看系统。有意思——节拍没乱。
shots.speaker: 熊伟

shots.detail_en: Long-lens shot across the hall: the young man below silently mouths a sentence, subtitle pressed over him; the man in black behind the glass shows zero reaction
shots.sub: （唇语·无声）你们十年前就盯上了我父亲？
shots.speaker: 长虹
shots.fx: one beat of silence with heartbeat

shots.detail_en: The man in black turns back to his screens, the red mark dimming out; below, the young man lowers his half-raised hand
Counter close-up: young man slides the last slip across to close the position, a small loss line on the paper, stylized; the clerk's stamp comes down
shots.speaker: 长虹

shots.detail_en: Black screen, white Chinese end card, subtle film grain
shots.sub: 十年前的那只眼睛，还睁着。
shots.card: 十年前的那只眼睛，还睁着。
